questions.text: As of 2026-11-05, how many sales have an overdue unpaid invoice balance, and what is the total overdue amount? Ignore voided sales.
What was the total invoiced revenue by sales channel for sales ordered between 2026-07-01 and 2026-09-30 inclusive? Ignore voided sales.
Who are the top 3 customers by total invoiced amount across all non-voided sales, and how much is each?
What is the total value of stock on hand across all locations, and which location holds the most value?
How many distinct products currently have negative available stock (summed across all locations)?
How many purchase orders are still awaiting receipt of goods? Ignore voided and completed ones.
